allow.why: Radix moves focus to the panel on open. The panel is a container, not a control, and its focus is programmatic; every control inside it keeps the ring.

touchAllow.why: The switch track (24px) is a glyph inside a 44px label row; the row is the target and the whole label is the name.
The 32px glyph above an empty-state title: an icon on the 14/16/20/32 scale, not a control.
